instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure total responsiveness with mobile-first approach and fluid typography
Use Portuguese (pt-BR) text strictly throughout the interface
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive button, card, schedule tab, and CTA for clean automated testing
Build a live status badge indicator showing if live production is happening right now (9h-13h seg-sex)
Implement interactive modal/drawer for WhatsApp appointment scheduling for Saturday live show
Create interactive Store/Gallery showcase with tabs for 'Todas as Peças', 'Taças', 'Copos', 'Decorativos Murano'
Add dynamic Google Maps direction launcher and interactive address card for Blumenau location
Use Framer Motion or smooth scroll effects to provide an award-worthy editorial museum experience

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Avoid standard bright templates. Use dark obsidian surfaces with glowing molten amber gradients and fine gold borders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous 2-3x padding in cards and sections to create dramatic museum atmosphere.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA standard against dark obsidian background (#0B0B0E).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attribute: Include data-testid on all interactive controls (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-cta-button', data-testid='schedule-live-show-btn').
